raw_policy: Only the two existing JSON string value tokens may differ. All prefix, separator, key-order, whitespace, escaping, Unicode encoding and suffix bytes are copied from the fresh raw source.
parsed_policy: After raw splicing, strict parsed equality is required against a clone of the fresh parsed document with exactly the two approved leaves changed.
anchor_policy: Each fixed widget anchor must occur exactly once and its encoded old value and following JSON boundary must match.
persistence_policy: One internal update_metadata call with compile-time post 2003 and _elementor_data coordinates; its return is diagnostic only.
verification_policy: Fresh persisted raw string, SHA-256, and strict parsed structure must all equal the exact expected candidate.
rollback_policy: Restore and freshly verify the exact captured pre-write raw string; numeric/string equivalence is never accepted.
